items.text: Support MES system by performing work in research, design, development and test of existing and new system modules, tools and processes required for operation.
Develop production reports according to user needs.
Prepare IT systems manuals, guides and training documents and conduct training to users.
Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth rollout of new IT applications at the professional level.
Coordinate to conduct IT related audit and complete documentation.
Support users' transactions and problems encountered in MES system.

description.text:
What you will be doing:
• Support MES system by performing work in research, design, development and test of existing and new system modules, tools and processes required for operation.
支持與維護 MES（製造執行系統）：透過研究、設計、開發及測試現有與新系統模塊、工 具與流程，滿足生產線的營運需求。
• Develop production reports according to user needs.
根據使用者需求開發生產報表
• Prepare IT systems manuals, guides and training documents and conduct training to users.
撰寫 IT 系統操作手冊與培訓文件，並對使用者進行培訓
• Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth rollout of new IT applications at the professional level.
跨部門協調，確保新 IT 應用順利導入，新應用能夠順利的部署到生產線。
• Coordinate to conduct IT related audit and complete documentation.
配合執行 IT 相關稽核並完成相關文檔
• Support users' transactions and problems encountered in MES system.
支援使用者在 MES 系統中的操作與問題排除
★起薪依學經歷而定★
★依個人工作考核不定期調薪★

• Knowledge of SQL programming (Oracle PL/SQL preferred)
具備 SQL 程式設計知識（以 Oracle PL/SQL 為佳）
• 2+ years of work experience related to MES system (PROMIS MES is preferred)
具備2年以上與製造執行系統(MES)相關的工作經驗（以PROMIS MES為佳）
• Proficient verbal and written English skills
具有較好的英語讀寫能力。
**Please make sure to attach your most updated English resume along with your 104 application.
